about_short_description.short_description: Goodcover is an insurance agency that sell property-casualty insurance products.

product.name: Renters Insurance
product.description: Insurance coverage protecting renters' personal property and liability against covered perils such as fire, theft, and water damage, including temporary housing costs if the rental becomes uninhabitable.

product.name: Goodcover Auto
product.description: A service helping renters find competitive car insurance rates from multiple providers, with multi-line discounts when bundled with Goodcover renters insurance.

product.name: Earthquake Insurance (via Partner)
product.description: Optional earthquake insurance coverage available through a partner company to supplement standard renters insurance policies.
